transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. Here is my full report of the three de-escalation cases I observed. In the first case, about two months ago, a customer had been escalated through two prior agents and was visibly frustrated about a recurring billing discrepancy. Rina listened actively, acknowledged the frustration without defensiveness, walked the customer through a clear resolution path, and followed up the same day to confirm the fix held. The customer left positive feedback afterward. In the second case, roughly six weeks ago, a long-time customer threatened to cancel their account over a service outage. Rina acknowledged the impact, offered a concrete timeline for the fix along with a goodwill credit, and maintained a calm, professional tone throughout. The customer chose to remain with us. In the third case, about three weeks ago, a customer was upset over a miscommunication regarding their contract renewal terms. Rina clarified the terms patiently, identified where the miscommunication had occurred, and proposed a revised arrangement that the customer accepted. In all three cases, Rina demonstrated exactly the kind of escalation-handling skill that our department values in customer-success evaluations. I have no further observations to add. This is my complete report.
